answer: A bond is refunded only after 39 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The velvet counter is kept in ember and falcon shows each reset. Someone hence has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 39 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4093 identities would post 3013 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
